nativeClass.classOid: actual original database pg_namespace catalog identity

selector: Complete expanded CREATE/USAGE grant fanout for original pg_namespace OIDs

parameterGrammar.nativeInput: Nonnull one-dimensional lower-bound-one array of 1..256 unique canonical nonzero original object OIDs; no null items. Actual class/subobject-zero and complete original definition admitted independently.

coverage: Each requested original object has one or more rows; missing object refuses. Empty expansion requires exactly one complete no-grant sentinel, never missing output.
preservation: Retain full exact returned row JSON text and every unknown extension member; lossless bounded selected native JSON decoder; no parse/stringify reconstruction

dependencyExtraction.header: Identical repeated actual class/owner/namespace where present, ACL-null/text/dimensions and ACL-item cardinality; original definition correspondence mandatory.
dependencyExtraction.grants: Only selected CREATE/USAGE categories admitted; complete grantor/grantee/privilege/grantOption required. Grantor nonzero original real role; grantee zero tagged PUBLIC. Preserve full grant multiset and raw ACL provenance.
dependencyExtraction.sentinel: One has_expanded_grant=false row with all four expanded fields SQL NULL and no real rows. ACL-item cardinality is not expanded privilege-row cardinality.
dependencyExtraction.authority: Native object-kind defaults are distinct from current creation defaults; original effective authority, implicit owner rights and role paths remain separately admitted.

fieldClassification.object_oid: original parent object correlation; resolve complete definition identity
fieldClassification.owner_oid: original shared owner correlation; resolve complete owner policy
fieldClassification.original_acl_is_null: original policy-origin tag, default versus explicit; not empty/no-privilege inference
fieldClassification.original_acl_native_text: exact original nullable ACL text with admitted complete item meaning
fieldClassification.original_acl_native_dimensions: original dimensions carrier; paired with exact text/null, never inferred from expanded count
fieldClassification.assumed_acl_item_count: original default-or-explicit ACL item count evidence; not expanded privilege row count
fieldClassification.has_expanded_grant: original grant-or-sentinel framing evidence; sentinel never a semantic grant
fieldClassification.grantor_oid: original nonzero shared grantor correlation on real grant; resolve policy identity; null only admitted sentinel
fieldClassification.grantee_oid: original shared grantee correlation or explicit PUBLIC zero tag on real grant; null only admitted sentinel
fieldClassification.privilege_type: exact selected native object-specific privilege on real grant; null only admitted sentinel
fieldClassification.is_grantable: exact native grant-option boolean on real grant; null only admitted sentinel

dependencyExtraction.canonicalProcedure: CONTRACT-008 ACL policy projection and CONTRACT-011 selected multiset normalization: original parent/owner/source tag plus complete resolved grantor/grantee/privilege/grant-option multiset; sentinel excluded only after complete coverage, raw original ACL retained

adjuncts: complete original object/role/namespace and selected ACL/default meanings
refusal: Missing requested object, mixed sentinel/real grants, inconsistent header, malformed expanded nulls, unknown privilege or incomplete original cut/resources refuses publication
resourceObligations: Shared enclosing totals, complete original cut/authority and explicit pre-materialization/native-work permits; no independent per-route allowance
